messages:
tara: quick sync - need a tight acceptance checklist for the new API slice contract (chat, embeddings, rerank). timebox: finalize by EOW. who takes which area?
jamal: i'll run chat/completions. slices: single-turn, convo-resume (KV), streaming. acceptance highlights: p95 latency targets, streaming continuity, resume correctness for KV.
alex: embeddings owner. slices: small (512), medium (1536), quantized. acceptance: dimension announced in response, nightly regression alert if mean cosine drops >0.03, upsert rejects on dim mismatch.
ben: rerank owner. slices: fast-score, score+explain. acceptance: >=5% lift vs baseline on heldout, deterministic tie-break, score-only p95 <120ms.
cindy: product notes: add per-request slice override and customer_pin for rollouts. pricing maps to slice family (avoid per-variant pricing). security: embeddings storage opt-in; KMS for private stores.
tara: edge cases to capture in PRD: truncated KV resume, client-supplied older model_version, streaming disconnect + tail regen, embedding dim mismatch on upsert, quantized read-path inconsistencies, rerank feature vector schema mismatch -> lexical fallback.
jamal: tests i'll draft: basic prompt smoke, 5-step convo resume, streaming reconnect, KV truncation simulate.
alex: embeddings tests: upsert dimension checks, async index cold-start, query p95 <=40ms for medium after indexing.
ben: rerank tests: tie-break determinism, 2k QPS score-only perf, failure-injection -> fallback verifies and trace tags.
tara: rollout outline: week1 internal + partners, week2 self-serve with throttles, week3 full. canary 5% with rollback. SLA gating for Dedicated after 4 weeks.
cindy: also require observability: per-request slice tag, sampled full explain logs, and telemetry for tokens/cost.
tara: action items: jamal -> chat acceptance + tests by Tue; alex -> embeddings acceptance + eval thresholds by Tue; ben -> rerank acceptance + bench plan by Wed; cindy -> rollout + pricing note. i'll assemble PRD and post link.
jen: fyi i9m in design, will add API surface notes once PRD lands.
tara: thanks all, update the thread if blockers. :thumbsup:
